name: github-release-policy
description: GitHub release automation for repositories using embedded standard lifecycle.

post-push.description: Create or update a GitHub release for the resolved version after pushing artifacts.

steps.run: git fetch --tags {{options.remote}} && if git rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/tags/{{version.SemVer}}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo TAG_EXISTS; fi

if [ "{{options.dry-run}}" = "true" ]; then echo DRY RUN: would create or update GitHub release "{{version.SemVer}}" for commit {{version.CommitSha}} (prerelease={{version.isPrerelease}}); if [ -n "{{options.testReportAssetPath}}" ] || [ -n "{{options.coverageReportAssetPath}}" ]; then echo DRY RUN: would upload release assets {{options.testReportAssetPath}} {{options.coverageReportAssetPath}} to release '{{version.SemVer}}'; fi; else gh release create "{{version.SemVer}}" --target "{{version.CommitSha}}" --prerelease "{{version.isPrerelease}}" --generate-notes || gh release edit "{{version.SemVer}}" --target "{{version.CommitSha}}" --prerelease "{{version.isPrerelease}}" --generate-notes; REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner)}; assets=""; if [ -n "{{options.testReportAssetPath}}" ]; then assets="{{options.testReportAssetPath}}"; fi; if [ -n "{{options.coverageReportAssetPath}}" ]; then if [ -z "$assets" ]; then assets="{{options.coverageReportAssetPath}}"; else assets="$assets {{options.coverageReportAssetPath}}"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$assets" ]; then gh release upload "{{version.SemVer}}" $assets --clobber; fi; fi
